scope: Generation-only replay of current engine at captured code identity; confirmed preclassified inputs, frozen fictional evidence. No original private transcript replay, STT, detector, retrieval search, or UI-render measurement.

reproducibility.note: Private run retains exact per-file source, configuration, request and context hashes. Later prompt, classification and length-control refinements were tested offline; these numbers do not measure those refinements.

historical_evidence.limitation: Metadata supports usage counts, not semantic duplication, accuracy, usefulness or first-useful-sentence timing. Original raw-text export could not be retrieved; no historical logs were modified.

retained_prior_analysis.limitation: Older first-word figures are contextual evidence only, not the current baseline or useful-sentence latency.

provider_incident.note: Late reachability failures affect all conditions and confound unconditional architecture comparisons. Missing or failed outputs remain in coverage denominators. Completed-pair comparisons are explicitly conditioned on delivery.

calibration_v1.reason: Invalid protocol host; no valid comparison results

calibration_v2.reason: Budget exhaustion; exploratory review unused in final quality results

cost_accounting.note: Usage-priced values are configured rate-card estimates from returned provider usage, not invoices. Unresolved reservations are conservative limits, not actual billed costs.

review.scalar_scores_note: One reviewer left scalar scores null; the other scored eight question groups. Preference and expansion flags are primary; no automatic semantic score was assigned. The separately selected missing-context diagnostic is excluded from these rates.

decision.reason: No blanket replacement is justified. Candidate removes automatic duplicate generation; reviewed delivered answers often preferred candidates, but first useful sentence improvement is not demonstrated. Adaptive/hybrid expert quality is unobserved in this run: no candidate expert request completed. Preserve legacy behind architecture flag and use opt-in comparisons.
validation_gates: Repeat the full interleaved corpus with healthy provider connectivity and measured expert completions.
Validate real speculative transcript revisions and end-to-end useful-sentence timing.
Calibrate grounding and usefulness with human blind review, including complex and missing-context cases.
